visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair, wearing a black hoodie with a small white chest logo, stands in a brightly lit shopping mall corridor. Behind him, department store displays, mannequins, and 'Sale' signs are visible. He gestures enthusiastically with his right hand while speaking directly to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a large graphic wall featuring two stylized blue and black snakes with red eyes in a traditional Japanese art style. The lighting is focused and direct. (3) The man appears in front of the snake graphic wall, pointing towards it. Clothing racks filled with various apparel items are partially visible to the left. He maintains a joyful and expressive facial expression. (4) Close-up shots show a white t-shirt featuring a detailed purple snake and a character graphic. A hand adjustments the fabric to show the print quality. The background is a dark, retail-style counter. (5) The man displays more merchandise, including a black hoodie and denim shorts with brand labels. He points to specific prints. The environment remains a well-lit retail pop-up space with wooden counters. (6) A series of close-up shots showcase apparel from an anime collaboration, featuring character prints of Toji Fushiguro from Jujutsu Kaisen. The clothing is laid flat on a display surface. (7) Back to the man holding a black t-shirt with an anime graphic. He is smiling and looking at the camera. Clothing racks with multiple shirts are visible in the soft-lit background. (8) The man stands in the store area, speaking with high energy. A small inset photo of an older man appears above his shoulder. He continues to gesture with his hands to emphasize his words. (9) The video concludes with the man pointing at the camera in a frontal shot, followed by a graphic end card showing his face inside a circular frame with a heart icon and text overlays on a black background.

The main speaker reacts with a loud, excited exclamation. (4) Multiple short, cartoonish 'pop' and 'bling' sound effects punctuate the dialogue as the speaker describes clothing designs. The sound of fabric rustling is audible during close-up item shots. (5) A comical 'slide' sound effect occurs when mentioning the designer's prank. The speaker's pitch remains high and enthusiastic throughout. (6) A heavy 'impact' stinger sound effect marks the announcement of the anime collaboration. The BGM volume swells slightly to match the hype. (7) 'Sparkle' sound effects accompany the description of a 'cool' anime character. The male voice exhibits high arousal and frequent rising intonations. (8) A 'glitch' or UI sound effect triggers as an inset photo is revealed. The background music continues without interruption. (9) The speaker's volume increases as he promotes the fan meeting event. Rapid-fire 'impact' SFX follow the beat of the music. (10) The audio track ends with a final enthusiastic 'Yeah!' shout from the speaker, followed by a quick fade-out of the BGM.

It aims to inform fans about a new pop-up store in Taipei, showcase the new Snake Year apparel collection, announce a major collaboration with the anime 'Jujutsu Kaisen', and drive attendance to an upcoming fan meeting event on January 18th.
